protocol.input: Unmodified publisher RescaleT(320) and ToTensorLab(flag=0): stretch the complete RGB image, image-maximum scaling and ImageNet channel normalization. EXIF orientation applied before source hash checks.
protocol.output: Publisher fused saliency head with per-image minimum/maximum normalization, threshold .5 for locator; constant field becomes zero.
protocol.pipeline: Keep every production crop. Only if none exists, accept an outline-supported neural proposal with observed rectified overlap >=99% and maximum axis-normalized extrapolation <=5%, always needs_review. Use analytic projective coverage; no mask score or template selects the crop.
protocol.selection: All 32 fixed source-balanced photos from the new selection plan.

scope: Prospective test of the fixed pretrained saliency model and new review-required partial-photo policy on 32 separately selected photos from five known source groups. This is not proof of new-source or new-motif generalization. No training. Numerical gates retained even if functional outcomes agree.
